Why it matters: Identifies who performs the work: applicant, employee, operator, manager, analyst, or another role
Identifies what the person or organization is actually doing
Identifies what is being counted and prevents a person count from being confused with an operator, submission, review, or event count
Identifies how often the activity occurs
Records how long the activity is assumed to take
Records how burden or Federal effort is valued
Distinguishes annual, one-time, three-year, per-person, per-event, and other measures
Preserves where the input or assumption came from
Connects a renewal or revision to the estimate that came before it
